brief: Why you should aim to be disliked by 50% of your audience.

slots.title: WHY HALF YOUR AUDIENCE SHOULD HATE YOU
PEOPLE PLEASING KILLS BRANDS
slots.body: You cannot be everything to everyone. When you try to please the entire world, your message dissolves into bland nothingness. Specificity is what builds a loyal tribe.

slots.title: POLARIZATION CREATES TRUE FANS
slots.body: Strong opinions attract the right people and repel the wrong ones. The ones who stay will buy, share, and defend your work. That is the goal.

slots.title: CONTROVERSY DRIVES ENGAGEMENT FAST
slots.body: Engagement is engagement, regardless of whether it comes from love or fury. Comments and shares push your content to new eyes. Let them argue.

slots.title: GENERIC CONTENT GETS IGNORED
slots.body: Safe advice is everywhere and remembered by no one. A bold stance forces a reaction. Even a negative reaction is better than silence.

slots.title: FILTERS ATTRACT DREAM CLIENTS
slots.body: When half walk away, the half that remains trusts you deeply. They see you as the only solution to their problem. That is premium positioning.

slots.title: START WITH ONE BOLD TAKE
slots.body: Pick a stance that genuinely excites you and state it clearly. Post it without apologizing. The right people will finally see you.
